final: WITH type_stats AS (SELECT m.Name AS media_type_name, AVG(t.UnitPrice) AS avg_list_price, AVG(1.0 * t.Bytes / t.Milliseconds) AS avg_size_per_millisecond FROM MediaType AS m LEFT JOIN Track AS t ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId AND t.Bytes >= 10323804 GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_size_per_millisecond) AS overall_avg_size_per_millisecond FROM type_stats) SELECT type_stats.media_type_name, type_stats.avg_list_price, type_stats.avg_size_per_millisecond, type_stats.avg_size_per_millisecond / overall.overall_avg_size_per_millisecond AS relative_avg_size_per_millisecond FROM type_stats CROSS JOIN overall WHERE overall.overall_avg_size_per_millisecond IS NOT NULL
